conditionalIdentity: For each exact native source, eta=Z/s^(1/2-h), X=R^2/(2s), and F(s)=s-Z^2*s^(2h)-T=0. If an actual reference input has Z=s^D*eta, T=s*(1-eta^2), s in [1/2,2], |eta|<=1 and 0<h<1/16, then F(s)=0 and Fprime>1-8h>1/2 throughout bracket. Thus the relevant defined root is unique, positive and X>=0.
